lines.text: Anthropic S-1/A: ~$17B Q3 revenue; ~$895B compute/infra commitments (Nasdaq: ANT)
Apple: Siri AI will have usage limits; paid expanded access later; GM guide 45–46%
Anthropic open-sources FlashProve zkSNARK for MoE inference (~110 tok/s on H100)

feed.headline: Anthropic S-1/A: ~$17B Q3 revenue (+47% q/q); ~$895B compute commitments
feed.why: Nine-month revenue $33.24B. Growth slowed from +144% in Q2. Nasdaq ANT; price range still blank.

feed.headline: Apple: Siri AI usage limits coming; paid expanded access later
feed.why: Ternus on the call. No prices or caps yet. Dec GM guided 45–46% on memory plus Siri AI ramp.

feed.headline: Anthropic S-1/A: may ‘imminently’ hit RSP bar for AI-accelerated progress
feed.why: Filing risk factor on AI speeding its own research. No model designated over the threshold yet.

feed.headline: Anthropic open-sources FlashProve zkSNARK for MoE inference
feed.why: ~110 tok/s on one H100 for Llama 4 Maverick 4-bit. Research prototype with Lean proofs, not a product.

feed.headline: Anthropic: Messages API message threads in public beta
feed.why: Send history once, then only new turns. ~35% median TTFT cut on 500k–1M-token requests. Pricing unchanged.

feed.headline: Palantir Q3 revenue +96% to $2.31B; US commercial tops government
feed.why: First time US commercial passed US gov. AIP-led; FY guide raised to about $8.53B.

feed.headline: Musk: Grok Bot limits cut; serving cost ‘unsustainably high’ vs revenue
feed.why: Fits Apple’s Siri caps and OpenAI’s shared ChatGPT+Codex allowance. Usage rationing is the cost story.

feed.headline: Deep Principle open-sources Hydrogen-1.0, a 753B science model (MIT)
feed.why: Built on GLM-5.3. ‘Beats Astra’ science scores are lab-only; no AA or Epoch score yet.

feed.headline: AMD fiscal Q3 after the close; call 5:00 PM ET
feed.why: Chip tape after Apple’s memory-cost warning. Watch AI GPU / Instinct commentary.

feed.headline: Kimi K3.1 Pro full weights still promised by Nov 4
feed.why: API and apps already live. As of this morning Moonshot’s HF org still shows Kimi-K3, not K3.1 Pro.
